description: This PHP source file defines the ACMPCAClient class within the Aws\ACMPCA namespace. The class extends AwsClient and includes method annotations for interacting with AWS Certificate Manager Private Certificate Authority service, providing methods for managing certificate authorities, certificates, permissions, policies, and related operations.
